title: The wiring program of a fly brain — accompanying code
description: Complete single-purpose analysis pipeline (194 scripts), paper build chain, registry ledger results and machine-readable logs accompanying the manuscript 'The wiring program of a fly brain'. Every number reported in the paper and its Supplementary Information can be regenerated end-to-end from the three public connectomes (MaleCNS v1.0, FlyWire FAFB v783, hemibrain v1.2) with this pipeline.
